projects.name: Cardswala.com
projects.desc: Developed a full-stack credit card comparison platform enabling users to explore, filter, and apply for credit cards by category. Built an AI-driven backend pipeline using Gemini and RAG to intelligently scrape, extract, and structure credit card data. Implemented the backend with Cursor and Trae stack. Designed and scaled the frontend using V0 and Next.js.
